reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
SSFW의 썸머 니트탑 트로피칼 그린 컬러는 정말 여름 그 자체를 담은 듯한 싱그러운 색감이 매력적이네요. 직접 입혀보니 화사한 그린 톤이 강아지의 뽀얀 털색과 대비되어 얼굴형이 확 살아나고, 야외 산책 시 초록초록한 배경과도 무척 잘 어우러집니다.
​가장 마음에 드는 점은 역시 소재감입니다. 여름용 니트라 혹시 덥지 않을까 걱정했는데, 통기성이 뛰어난 성근 조직감 덕분에 바람이 잘 통해 아이가 쾌적해 보여요. 신축성도 적당해서 활동량이 많은 아이가 뛰어놀거나 휴식을 취할 때도 몸에 부드럽게 밀착되어 전혀 불편해하지 않습니다.
​마감 처리 또한 매우 깔끔하고 고급스러워요. 목 부분과 소매 라인이 탄탄하게 잡혀 있어 여러 번 세탁해도 형태 변형이 적을 것 같습니다. 디자인이 과하지 않으면서도 트로피칼 특유의 경쾌한 무드가 느껴져, 올여름 휴양지 룩이나 데일리 산책 룩으로 이만한 아이템이 없을 것 같네요. 예쁘고 시원한 여름 옷을 찾고 계신 보호자님들께 강력 추천합니다!
#체험단
reviews.content_en:
SSFW's Summer Knit Top in Tropical Green has such a fresh and vibrant color that really captures the essence of summer itself. When I put it on my pup, the bright green tone creates a beautiful contrast with his pristine white fur, making his face shape really stand out, and it looks absolutely gorgeous with the green surroundings on outdoor walks.

What I love most is definitely the fabric quality. I was a bit worried it might be too warm for a summer knit, but thanks to the excellent breathability and loosely woven texture, air flows right through and my pup seems so comfortable. The elasticity is just right too, so even with an active pup, whether he's running around or resting, the fabric hugs his body softly without any discomfort whatsoever.

The finishing is also incredibly neat and luxurious. The neckline and sleeve edges are firmly constructed, so I don't think the shape will change much even after multiple washes. The design isn't over the top, yet it has that light and breezy tropical vibe—I can't think of a better piece for a summer getaway look or everyday walks. I highly recommend this to anyone looking for a pretty and cool summer outfit for their pup!
#ExperienceTeam

reviews.name: 남****
reviews.content:
#체험단
이번 체험단으로 받아본 SSFW 강아지 썸머 니트 탑 - 트로피컬 그린 💚
여름용 강아지 옷이라 얇고 시원한 소재감이 가장 마음에 들었어요! 니트 소재인데도 가볍고 통기성이 좋아서 후추가 답답해하지 않고 편하게 입더라구요. 신축성도 좋아서 활동하기 편해 보였고, 산책할 때 입혀보니 움직임도 자연스러웠어요🐶✨
트로피컬 그린 컬러가 너무 쨍하지 않고 산뜻해서 털색이랑도 잘 어울리고 사진도 정말 예쁘게 나왔어요📸 포인트 되는 느낌이라 여름에도 자주 입힐 것 같아요! 얇아서 한여름까지 부담 없이 입기 좋고 마감이나 핏도 만족스러웠던 제품입니다 :)
reviews.content_en:
#ExperienceTeam
I received the SSFW Dog Summer Knit Top in Tropical Green as part of this experience team 💚
I loved the thin and cool fabric quality the most since it's a summer dog outfit! Even though it's knit material, it's lightweight and has great breathability, so Peppered doesn't feel stuffy and wears it comfortably. The elasticity is great too, so it seems easy to move around in, and when I took him on a walk, his movements looked so natural 🐶✨
The tropical green color isn't too bright and has a fresh feel that matches his coat color perfectly, and the photos came out really pretty 📸 It's such a standout piece that I think we'll be wearing it a lot throughout the summer! It's thin enough to wear comfortably even in the height of summer, and I was satisfied with both the finishing and fit :)

reviews.name: 손****
reviews.content:
강아지 원 사이즈!
가슴둘레 37-39 센치
몸무게 3.6 키로
등 길이 27 센치

#체험단 으로 당첨되었어요~^^
평소 SSFW브랜드의 옷을 구매해서 입혀보기도 했었고, 
워낙 디자인도 심플하고! 깔끔해서 좋은 기억이 있었어요~
이후 체험단에 혹시나해서 신청했는데 당첨되니 더 반갑더라구요!! 여름 옷은 까다롭게 고를 수 밖에 없어서 신중할 수 밖에 없는데, SSFW 니트 탑은 옷감도 부드럽고 강아지 피부나 털에 닿을 때 엉켜지거나 정전기가 나지 않는 소재더라구요~
그리고 여름 날씨 특성상 미용을 자주 할 수 밖에 없는데, 그때마다 뜨거운 열에 바로 노츌 될 수 있어요.. 하지만 강아지들의 피부는 워낙 여리기 때문에 아무리 더워도 피부자체를 보호해 줄 만한 얇고 시원한 소재의 옷이 필수인거 같더라구요~
냉감옷도 좋고, 얇은 민소매 티셔츠도 좋은데 SSFW니트탑은
니트 특유의 통기성이 있어서 매우 시원할 것 같아요.
자세히 보면 강아지 털이 비춰질 정도이고, 제 손을 넣어봐도 속이 잘 보인답니다. 그만큼 자외선 노출에는 걱정이 없으며! 통기성은 확실하게 보장되는 옷이라는 거에요~🤗

느낀점 : 통기성 좋음 / 정전기가 적은 니트소재 / 무게가벼움/ 신축성 좋음 / 마감처리 잘 되어 있음.
reviews.content_en:
Dog Size One!
Chest Circumference: 37-39cm
Weight: 3.6kg
Back Length: 27cm

#ExperienceTeam I got selected~~^^
I've purchased SSFW brand clothes before and tried them on, and I always had great memories because the designs are so simple and clean!
I applied for the experience team on a whim, and I was so happy when I actually got selected!! Summer clothes are hard to choose since you have to be picky, so I'm naturally cautious. But the SSFW Knit Top has soft fabric that doesn't tangle or cause static when it touches my dog's skin and fur~
Also, because of the summer weather, we have to groom frequently, and every time we do, our pups can be exposed to intense heat right after... But since dog skin is so delicate, even in extreme heat, you really need thin, cool clothing that protects their skin. Cooling clothes are great, and thin sleeveless tees are nice too, but the SSFW Knit Top has the inherent breathability of knit material, so it should be extremely cool.
When you look closely, you can actually see through to the dog's fur, and even when I put my hand inside, I can see right through. That means there's no worry about UV exposure, and it definitely guarantees breathability~ 🤗

Key Points: Excellent breathability / Low-static knit material / Lightweight / Great elasticity / Well-finished construction.

reviews.name: 최****
reviews.content:
#체험단
일단 여름과 너무 잘어울리는 쨍한 색감이예요. 얼굴에 형광등 비춘것같이 해줘서 단독으로도 충분히 매력 뿜뿜 내뿜을 수 있어요. 한여름에는 입기 조금 더울 수 있는 두께지만 구멍이 뽕뽕 뚫려있어서 통풍이 잘 되어 좋은것 같아요. 여름이여도 피부문제 진드기문제로 옷 안입을수 없잖아요? 그렇다고 매일 쿨티입자니 조금 더 멋부리고 싶을때 있잖아요? 그럴때 딱입니다!! 일반적인 면 소재가 아닌 니트 소재다보니 조금 더 분위기 내기에 좋아요~근데 무엇보다도 색감이 미쳤어요!! 흔하게 찾아볼수 있는 색이 아닌게 또 소장가치도 좋구요!!
reviews.content_en:
#ExperienceTeam
First of all, the bright color goes perfectly with summer. It's like shining a fluorescent light on the face, so it can look attractive and charming all on its own. In the height of summer it might be a bit thick to wear, but since it has lots of holes for ventilation, the airflow is great. Even in summer, you can't go without clothes because of skin and mite issues, right? But then again, you don't want to wear just a cool tee every day when you want to look a bit more stylish sometimes, you know? This is perfect for those moments!! Since it's knit material rather than regular cotton, it's better for creating that vibe~ But most importantly, the color is insane!! It's not a color you see everywhere, so it has great collector's value too!!

reviews.name: 서****
reviews.content_en:
#ExperienceTeam
I knew SSFW uses quality fabric, so I applied for the experience team right away
It fits perfectly (Chest 40cm, Back Length 28cm, Weight 5kg), and the back length is just right with the shoulders not slipping down, which is great. Even though it's knit, it's lightweight and thin, so I think I can wear it even in the height of summer, and the green color makes it even prettier. I'll wear it well!

reviews.name: 감****
reviews.content:
여름에도 입을수 있고 답답하지 않은 니트탑 ♡
저희집 강아지는 평소 s사이즈 입히는데 모량이 많아서 m으로 여유있게 입혀봤어요~ 여름이라 쨍한 그린컬러 픽했는데 갈색 친구들한테 너무 어울리는 색갈이에요!
reviews.content_en:
A knit top you can wear even in summer without feeling stuffy ♡
My pup usually wears size S, but since he has a lot of hair, I got him a M for a roomier fit~ Since it's summer, I picked the bright green color, and it looks so great on my brown-furred friend!
